purpose: Global sticky header: brand mark, primary navigation (three dropdown panels plus two direct links), a persistent Get started CTA and a Log in link, collapsing to a full-screen accordion menu below lg. It is the always-present route into pricing, tour and sign-up.

behaviour.note: Rendered once by App.jsx outside <Routes>, so it is global and not part of any page component. Sticky: header is `sticky top-0 z-50 bg-background`, always visible, no scroll-dependent change in size or colour.

Desktop hover model: a panel opens 200ms after the pointer enters a trigger when nothing is open; it opens instantly if another panel is open or within 300ms of a close; it closes 150ms after the pointer leaves trigger plus panel; click toggles; Escape and outside mousedown close. Only pointerType 'mouse' drives hover.
Desktop panels cross-fade: the outgoing panel exits while the incoming one enters (each trigger owns its own Presence).

Mobile menu (below lg) is a full-screen fixed panel below the header, shown/hidden instantly with no enter or exit animation. Its sections are a multi-open accordion (several can be open); tapping a link closes the menu.

The mobile menu is rendered as a sibling after the header's Container row, inside the header element. The Get started button stays visible in the bar next to the Menu button below lg; Log in moves into the mobile panel footer.

variants.name: desktop
variants.description: lg and up: inline nav with Platform, Company and Resources triggers (chevron, mono uppercase label) opening absolutely positioned panels; Pricing and Tour are plain links; Log in (outline) and Get started (primary) on the right.

variants.name: mobile
variants.description: below lg: nav hidden; Get started plus a 74px-wide Menu/Close outline toggle; opens the full-screen accordion menu with Log in and Get started stacked (side by side from md).

variants.name: platform-panel
variants.description: 590px wide panel: Products list (thumbnail, name, one-line description), a 210px Works-with column (link list with an optional tag chip), and a Trust Center footer row with three compliance labels.

variants.name: link-list-panel
variants.description: 232px wide panel of icon plus label links, used by Company (2 items) and Resources (6 items).

content.note: The component takes no props; content is module constants. The fields below describe those constants so a generator can re-skin them.
